0022600120.text: The Timberwolves come in 3-0 after three games, with a 2-0 mark on the road, a three-game winning streak, and a spot 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, while the Cavaliers are 1-1 with a 1-0 home record, a W1 streak, and a 3rd-place standing in the Central, 1.5 games back and 9th in the East. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota with an Achilles injury following surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their most recent meeting was a 146-134 Cleveland win on January 10, 2026 in Cleveland, with no games yet between them in 2026-27.
